new_engineering.mode: Distinct sampler seeds after private same-anchor restore; frozen parent and original timing code

admission.first_windows: All of the first min(60, comparable) original decision windows must be exact.
admission.short_fragment_allowance: Fewer than 200 comparable windows may have exactly one non-exact window, after the first 60 and only when the first slot used the preceding word and the remaining three slots used the sampled word.
admission.inputs: Every retained decision must have provable native consumption. Independently re-forward the frozen policy, retain the actual sealed endpoint and bind the next camera for every playable cutoff.

holdout: Keep discovery, engineering, rollout and held roles disjoint. From-anchor tests share a starting state and stochastic continuation. Final host rollout starts from the stock Game Start menu.
